title: Recipe
description: A single structured recipe record. Designed so ingredients can later be matched against grocery-store catalogs (e.g. Oppidu) for price comparison.

grocery_category.description: Category used to map this ingredient to a grocery store's catalog for price comparison

generated_by.description: Model/agent that generated this recipe, if source is ai-generated

status.description: Workflow state. All 19 seed recipes are 'published'. A recipe coming out of the submission flow starts as 'draft' while being built and becomes 'submitted' once finalized — there is no account/review system yet to promote it to 'published'.

submitted_by.description: User id, once user accounts exist. Always null today — login/accounts are intentionally not built yet; submissions are anonymous placeholders until then.

submitted_kitchen.description: Optional free-text name the submitter organizes their own recipes under, e.g. "Nina's Kitchen" — independent of accounts (see submitted_by); lets one person's submissions read as a recognizable little collection without needing a login.

photos_needed.description: TODO markers for photos this recipe should eventually have — no image-generation pipeline is wired up yet. Values reference what the shot is: 'ingredients' (all ingredients measured out in bowls/plates), 'step-<n>' (a key step, 1-indexed into instructions — e.g. roasting spices, searing), or 'final' (the completed dish).

translations.description: Optional hand-translated (or later, machine-translated) copies of the recipe's display text, keyed by language code. The English fields above (title, description, ingredients[].name, instructions) always remain the source of truth; a translation is used only when the UI's language toggle selects that language, and falls back to English for anything a translation omits.

ingredient_names.description: Translated ingredient names, positionally aligned with the top-level `ingredients` array (same length, same order) — quantity/unit/grocery_category are not duplicated here.

instructions.description: Translated instructions, positionally aligned with the top-level `instructions` array.
